title: Upgrade All Dependencies to Latest Versions
description: Systematically upgrade all dependencies in package.json to their latest versions, including major version bumps with breaking changes. Dependencies will be grouped by type (framework, build tools, test dependencies, etc.) for safer, more manageable upgrades.

title: US-001: Analyze current dependencies and plan upgrade batches
description:
As a developer, I want to understand the current dependency landscape and group dependencies by type so that I can upgrade them in logical, safe batches.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Read package.json and list all dependencies and devDependencies
- [ ] Check latest versions available for each package using npm registry
- [ ] Group dependencies into categories: framework deps, build tools, testing deps, linting/formatting, type definitions, utilities
- [ ] Identify which packages have major version bumps (breaking changes)
- [ ] Document the upgrade plan with version changes for each batch
- [ ] Create a rollback documentation file with current versions
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-002: Create safety branch and backup mechanism
description:
As a developer, I want a safe working branch and documented rollback steps so that I can revert changes if something goes wrong.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create a feature branch for dependency upgrades (e.g., feat/upgrade-dependencies-2026)
- [ ] Document current package.json state (copy to backup file or commit hash)
- [ ] Create ROLLBACK.md with steps to revert each upgrade batch
- [ ] Document the branch name and rollback process in the upgrade plan
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-003: Upgrade framework dependencies
description:
As a developer, I want to upgrade core framework dependencies (React, Vue, Next.js, etc.) to their latest versions so that I can access new features and security patches.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify framework dependencies from the analysis
- [ ] Upgrade framework packages to latest versions
- [ ] Update package.json and run pnpm install
- [ ] Fix any TypeScript errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any lint errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any test failures introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Update code to use new APIs if old ones are deprecated
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-004: Upgrade build tool dependencies
description:
As a developer, I want to upgrade build tools (webpack, vite, esbuild, rollup, etc.) to their latest versions so that I can benefit from build performance improvements.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify build tool dependencies from the analysis
- [ ] Upgrade build tool packages to latest versions
- [ ] Update package.json and run pnpm install
- [ ] Update build configurations if required by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any TypeScript errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any lint errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Verify build completes successfully
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-005: Upgrade testing dependencies
description:
As a developer, I want to upgrade testing libraries (Jest, Vitest, Testing Library, etc.) to their latest versions so that I can use improved testing features.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify testing dependencies from the analysis
- [ ] Upgrade testing packages to latest versions
- [ ] Update package.json and run pnpm install
- [ ] Update test configurations if required by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any TypeScript errors in test files
- [ ] Fix any lint errors in test files
- [ ] Fix any failing tests due to API changes
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-006: Upgrade linting and formatting dependencies
description:
As a developer, I want to upgrade ESLint, Prettier, and related tools to their latest versions so that I can use the latest code quality rules.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify linting/formatting dependencies from the analysis
- [ ] Upgrade linting and formatting packages to latest versions
- [ ] Update package.json and run pnpm install
- [ ] Update ESLint/Prettier configs if required by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any new lint errors introduced by stricter rules
- [ ] Fix any TypeScript errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Run lint on entire codebase to verify
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-007: Upgrade type definition dependencies
description:
As a developer, I want to upgrade @types/* packages to their latest versions so that TypeScript has accurate type information.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify @types/* dependencies from the analysis
- [ ] Upgrade all @types/* packages to latest versions
- [ ] Update package.json and run pnpm install
- [ ] Fix any TypeScript errors introduced by updated type definitions
- [ ] Fix any lint errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Verify all type checking passes
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-008: Upgrade utility and remaining dependencies
description:
As a developer, I want to upgrade all remaining utility libraries and miscellaneous dependencies to their latest versions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify remaining dependencies not covered in previous stories
- [ ] Upgrade all remaining packages to latest versions
- [ ] Update package.json and run pnpm install
- [ ] Fix any TypeScript errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any lint errors introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] Fix any test failures introduced by breaking changes
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes

title: US-009: Document upgrade results and create follow-up issues
description:
As a developer, I want to document all changes made and create issues for any unresolved problems so that the upgrade is properly tracked.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create UPGRADE_SUMMARY.md documenting all version changes
- [ ] List all breaking changes encountered and how they were fixed
- [ ] If any breaking changes couldn't be resolved, create follow-up beads issues
- [ ] Document any deprecated APIs that should be migrated in the future
- [ ] Update ROLLBACK.md with final rollback instructions
- [ ] Verify all quality gates pass one final time
- [ ] pnpm typecheck passes
- [ ] pnpm lint passes
- [ ] pnpm test passes
